meta.name: azure-reliability
meta.description: Assess and improve the reliability posture of PaaS Applications (Azure Functions and Azure App Service). Scans deployed resources for zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, and multi-region failover. Presents a feature-pivoted checklist, then drives staged remediation (CLI or IaC patches) end-to-end with user confirmation. WHEN: "assess reliability", "check reliability", "zone redundant", "multi-region failover", "high availability", "disaster recovery", "single points of failure", "reliability posture", "resiliency".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描并修复 Azure PaaS 应用的可靠性问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责 Azure 上应用的高可用与灾备配置。
copy.tagline_en: Scan and fix reliability issues in Azure PaaS apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage high availability and disaster recovery for Azure apps.

howto.what: 扫描你的 Azure Functions 和 App Service 资源，检查区域冗余、存储冗余、健康探测和多区域故障转移等可靠性特性，然后生成一个清单，并引导你逐步修复发现的问题。
howto.when: 当你提到“评估可靠性”、“检查区域冗余”、“设置多区域故障转移”等关键词，或要求检查高可用性、灾难恢复时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查我的 Function App 的可靠性。
say.note: 技能会扫描并生成可靠性清单。

say.text: 让我的应用支持区域冗余。
say.note: 技能会引导你启用区域冗余。
技能会询问并协助配置多区域故障转移。

howto.what_en: Scans your Azure Functions and App Service resources for reliability features like zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, and multi-region failover. Presents a checklist and guides you through staged remediation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "assess reliability", "zone redundant", "multi-region failover", or ask about high availability or disaster recovery.

say_en.text: Check the reliability of my Function App.
say_en.note: The skill will scan and generate a reliability checklist.
The skill will guide you through enabling zone redundancy.
The skill will ask and help configure multi-region failover.
